data.headline: Can Intel's foundry business help it catch up to TSMC in 2025?
data.summary: Intel (INTC) stock has had a difficult 2024, with shares falling roughly 60% year-to-date. As investors turn to 2025, Yahoo Finance Senior Reporter Yasmin Khorram and Reporter Laura Bratton sit down with Market Domination hosts Julie Hyman and Josh Lipton to discuss what's next for the struggling chipmaker, including the shift to a new CEO following Pat Gelsinger's surprise departure at the start of the month. To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Domination here. This post was written by Naomi Buchanan.
